MILITES.name: Milites
MILITES.ability: Bread-and-butter swordsman. Solid sustained single-target DPS at chokepoints. 12% crit at 2× — fast enough that a Cavalry Spur turns him into a meat grinder.

VELITES.name: Velites
VELITES.ability: SKIRMISHER: very fast javelins. Applies a brutal 50% Slow on every hit.

HASTATI.name: Hastati
HASTATI.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): CLEAVE: hits every enemy in melee range each swing (secondaries 70%). Front-line workhorse — pile multiple enemies into a chokepoint to multiply effective DPS.

SAGITTARIUS.name: Sagittarius
SAGITTARIUS.ability: Targets flyers only. WING CLIP: flyer hits Slow by 35% for a short window. Heavy damage, long range, +45% damage vs Flyers — the early-game answer to fast air leaks.

SCORPIO.name: Scorpio
SCORPIO.ability: Slow, devastating SIEGE ballista. HARPOON BOLT: flyer hits Slow and apply ARMOR SHRED, helping every follow-up tower punch through. +40% damage vs Bosses and +30% damage vs Flyers. Flying bosses take both bonuses multiplicatively (+82%). Siege bypasses ranged resists.

TRIARIUS.name: Triarius
TRIARIUS.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): CLEAVE + GLOBAL AURA: hits every enemy in melee range AND grants +12% damage to all your towers map-wide. Veteran spearman who buffs the line behind him.

DECURION.name: Decurion
DECURION.ability: CLOSE-ORDER OFFICER: melee range 2.0. EXECUTE: +250% damage vs non-boss enemies below 40% HP. Crit every 5th hit.

CENTURION.name: Centurion
CENTURION.ability: Heavy sword + ARMOR SHRED on every hit (3s) — drops enemy resists so ranged towers behind him chunk through faster. Cornerstone of any melee chokepoint.

PRIMUS_PILUS.name: Primus Pilus
PRIMUS_PILUS.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): FIRST SPEAR: huge crit profile, slow swings, dedicated boss-killer. +125% damage vs Bosses at T4, +250% at T5 (the senior centurion plants the standard and drives the pilum through bosses' chests). Standard +50% vs Bosses at T1-T3.

LEGATE.name: Legate
LEGATE.ability: Commander staff. Slow divine projectile with 1.0-tile splash. Single-target SLOW (40% for 2.5s) on primary hit. Mid-range support unit — solid baseline AoE for clearing waves.

AUXILIA.name: Skizzer
AUXILIA.ability: Tier III arena gladiator (the historical Scissor class — curved blade strapped to the forearm). Lightning-fast single-target melee (2.45/s) with an elite crit profile (22% / x2.1). Hit-and-run slicer that combos viciously with a Centurion's Armor Shred.

FUNDIBULUS.name: Fundibulus
FUNDIBULUS.ability: Tier III Balearic slinger. Arcing sling-stone with 0.6-tile splash. Applies SLOW (30% for 2.5s) on every hit — kites entire grouped lanes through chokepoints.

RORARIUS.name: Equites
RORARIUS.ability: Tier III skirmisher. Extremely fast darts (2.75/s) — +35% damage vs Runners. Specializes in pinning swarm waves at chokepoints with sustained chip damage.

LIBRITOR.name: Librator
LIBRITOR.ability: Tier III melee bruiser (POLEARM REACH 2.0). Every 3rd swing applies a 0.84s STUN to the target — the maker of openings, perfect for stacking with cleave allies and follow-up burst. PHYSICAL-MELEE damage; bring him to the front line, not the back row.

ACCENSUS.name: Accensus
ACCENSUS.ability: Tier III shock infantry. BRUTAL OPENER: +75% damage on enemies above 85% HP — front-loads damage on fresh spawns and shredded shielded enemies. Synergizes hard with Shield Bash + cleave towers.

RETIARIUS.name: Retiarius
RETIARIUS.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): TRIDENT & NET (melee): first hit on a new target deals 2× damage (the net pins them before the trident drives home). Applies Armor Shred on every strike — the on-hit shred AND the first-strike spike scale dramatically with tier.

BALLISTARIUS.name: Turris
BALLISTARIUS.ability: SIEGE KICKBACK (heavy-hitter): 68 base DPS at a slow 0.34/sec means each bolt lands roughly 200 damage on a clean target — the largest single-shot in the early-game siege roster. 1.1-tile splash on every shot. Every 3rd bolt also KNOCKS the primary target back along the path (~0.45 tiles), buying your maze extra ticks. Reward for the slow reload: every shot is a real event.

OPTIO.name: Optio
OPTIO.ability: Tier II officer. Fast command javelins; chips armor on hit.

PUGIO_ASSASSIN.name: Pugio Assassin
PUGIO_ASSASSIN.ability: BACKSTAB: +50% damage vs Runner archetype. Very fast melee (2.05/s) with a 28% crit profile — the prime assassin for Celtic Scouts, Spectral Scouts, Numidian Riders, Ghost Riders, Shadow Cavalry.

ARCUBALLISTA.name: Arcuballista
ARCUBALLISTA.ability: Slow heavy bolt — single-target (no splash). 10% crit × 2.4 makes spike-shots common; pairs with damage items for boss pressure.

VENATOR.name: Venator
VENATOR.ability: MARKED PREY: flyer hits Slow briefly and mark them for +35% damage from all sources. Fast bow that turns one flying target into a kill callout for the whole maze.

IGNIFER.name: Ignifer
IGNIFER.ability: Tier III fire-bearer. Hits leave BURNING GROUND for 4.4s — anything walking through takes burn.

SPECULATOR.name: Speculator
SPECULATOR.ability: SPOTTER: applies Mark (+15% damage taken) AND Armor Shred. Fastest scout.

FLAMEN.name: Flamen
FLAMEN.ability: Tier III priest. Divine projectile with 0.8-tile splash. Every hit applies a brief 0.6s STUN to the primary target. Mid-range divine support.

CARROBALLISTA.name: Carroballista
CARROBALLISTA.ability: TWIN ARTILLERY: fires at 2 separate targets per attack, each bolt landing a 1.4-tile splash. Slow reload but huge swept-fire output when enemies cluster. PHYSICAL-RANGED damage — the chassis throws bolts, not stones (siege class is reserved for the heavier Scorpio + Onager line).

CATAPHRACT.name: Cataphract
CATAPHRACT.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): Tier IV armored cavalry. Slow lance charges with bone-cracking crit profile (14% × 2.6) — every hit feels like a hammer drop. Pairs perfectly with chokepoint mazing.

AUGUR.name: Augur
AUGUR.ability: Divine orb with 0.65-tile splash. OMEN: every 6th hit lands a 1.5s FREEZE on the primary target in addition to the standard divine impact.

EVOCATUS.name: Evocatus
EVOCATUS.ability: TACTICAL STACKS: +5% damage per kill, capped at +50%. Veteran called back to service — at cap (10 kills) he deals 1.50× damage from the next swing on. Plant him at the kill funnel and watch him snowball.

HARUSPEX.name: Haruspex
HARUSPEX.ability: FORESIGHT: 20% chance to double-strike. Divine splash + stun.

CLIBANARIUS.name: Clibanarius
CLIBANARIUS.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0). BOSS HUNTER: +75% damage vs Bosses. Every 4th hit on a Boss is a CHARGED LANCE EXECUTE — 3× damage (rhythm: 3 stabs → 1 lance strike). BEAST RIDER: +100% damage vs animal-faction enemies (Feral / Rabid / Alpha Dog · Demon Hellhound · War Elephant · Undead War Elephant) — the heavy lance skewers four-legged beasts.

PRAEFECTUS.name: Praefectus
PRAEFECTUS.ability: Tier V field officer. Long-reach command fire; +45% damage to Elites and Bosses. A sharper late-game officer piece for commander and boss cleanup.

VULCAN_ENGINEER.name: Vulcan Engineer
VULCAN_ENGINEER.ability: Tier V siege artisan. Extremely slow attack (0.20/s base) but lobs a heavier fire-barrel with a 2.0-tile splash. Every hit stamps a BURNING GROUND patch (4.4s, 4–7% maxHP/sec scaling with tier) covering everyone in the splash zone.

IMPERATOR_GUARD.name: Imperator Guard
IMPERATOR_GUARD.ability: ELITE CLEAVE + IMPERIAL GUARD: hits every enemy in melee range each swing (70% to secondaries). Apex T5 melee — heavy DPS, monstrous crit profile (20% × 2.6), single-handedly holds a chokepoint against most non-boss ground waves.

SOLAR_PRIEST.name: Solar Priest
SOLAR_PRIEST.ability: SOLAR FLARE: ignores faction resistance whenever the target is RESISTING this damage type (neutral and weak targets get normal damage; a hard counter to phys-resistant factions). Divine splash 1.15 tiles.

COLOSSUS_ONAGER.name: Colossus Onager
COLOSSUS_ONAGER.ability: EARTHSHATTER: massive 2.4-tile splash on every shot. Every hit also KNOCKS the primary target back along the path (~0.7 tiles). Slowest fire rate in the game; trade-off is huge swept areas per shot.

AQUILA_VENATOR.name: Aquila Venator
AQUILA_VENATOR.ability: Tier III sky hunter. Targets flyers only. EAGLE SNARE: flyer hits Slow by 45% and mark for +25% damage taken. Two-shot attacks and devastating crits make it the mid-game air-control anchor.

HORSEMAN.name: Horseman
HORSEMAN.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): CHARGE applies MARK on hit (+20% next damage from anyone). Every strike also smears VENOM on the lance: 4.4s POISON DoT (5% maxHP/sec, scales with tier). Mark + poison + +20% vs ground = fast cavalry that erodes single targets while everyone else piles on.

SCORPION_BOLT.name: Scorpion Bolt
SCORPION_BOLT.ability: TRIPLE BOLT (SIEGE): fires three siege bolts at distinct targets per attack. SKY PIN: flyer hits briefly Stun and apply ARMOR SHRED. Pierces aerial plating, +100% damage vs Flyers, and +50% damage vs Bosses, multiplicative on flying bosses. Mid-game boss-killer plus anti-air control in one combo.

COHORT_GUARD.name: Cohort Guard
COHORT_GUARD.ability: SHIELD WALL CLEAVE: hits all enemies in melee range, +15% damage aura to nearby towers, slow on hit.

WAR_CHARIOT.name: War Chariot
WAR_CHARIOT.ability: TRAMPLE (MELEE — POLEARM REACH 2.0): every 3rd strike stuns (0.84s) AND knocks back ground enemies. +75% vs Bosses. The chariot runs in close and rolls over the line — physical-melee damage, parks adjacent to the path like Horseman / Turma Lancers.

EAGLE_STANDARD.name: Eagle Standard
EAGLE_STANDARD.ability: Global +10% damage. A separate aura gives nearby towers within 5 tiles +22% attack speed. Pure support — does no direct damage.

PLAGUE_CART.name: Plague Cart
PLAGUE_CART.ability: POISON CLOUD: 1.2-tile splash applies POISON at 6% max HP per second for 2.75s and SLOWS 50% for 3s. Active poison halves continuous regeneration. Every 3rd cloud blocks regeneration and checkpoint healing for 2s.

NUMIDIAN_CAVALRY.name: Eques
NUMIDIAN_CAVALRY.ability: Hits BOTH ground and flyers. NET VOLLEY: rains javelins at 3 distinct flyers per attack, Slowing them by 45% and marking them for +25% damage taken. 30% chance to land a triple-damage strike. +150% damage vs Flyers. Longer reach and stronger marks make it a real bridge into combo anti-air.

PRAETORIAN_WALL.name: Praetorian Wall
PRAETORIAN_WALL.ability: WALL CLEAVE: hits all enemies in melee range with a 45% slow on every hit. LAST STAND: every 8th attack knocks the target backward along the path, interrupting checkpoint heals.

AERARIUM.name: Aerarium
AERARIUM.ability: TREASURY: every kill it lands pays +4 Gold. Max 3 on the map. Its fast javelins and 4.5-tile reach help it secure its own income without a babysitter tower.

SIEGE_ONAGER.name: Siege Onager
SIEGE_ONAGER.ability: Massive 3.0-tile splash AoE. Every hit applies a 0.84s STUN to the primary target and stamps a BURNING GROUND patch (4.4s, 5–8% maxHP/sec scaled by tier) at the impact point.

AQUILIFER_TITAN.name: Aquilifer
AQUILIFER_TITAN.ability: Global +35% damage aura. Nearby enemies take +25% damage.

INFERNO_CART.name: Inferno Cart
INFERNO_CART.ability: Burn 6% HP/sec. Leaves a long-lasting BURNING GROUND for 5.5s on every hit — the longest-burning fire tower.

FROZEN_LEGION.name: Frozen Legion
FROZEN_LEGION.ability: Every hit FREEZES the target 2.5s — locked in place, no movement, no knockback displacement. GLACIAL PULSE every 8s freezes all enemies on the field for 2.5s, giving mixed defenses a reliable global control window.

JULIUS_CAESAR.name: Julius Caesar
JULIUS_CAESAR.ability: MELEE: stronger gladius strike at 2.0 tiles. Global +55% damage aura. Pulses a 5.5-tile AoE stun every 3s — the magisterial command extends well past sword reach. Bosses in the pulse take Armor Shred. IMPERIAL EXECUTE: any enemy left at 10% HP or below after Caesar's swing is killed instantly — bosses included. Flyers also qualify, but Caesar can only reach them if equipped with AQUILA TALONS (or placed on the CYAN aura tile / under Agricola's anti-air passive).

HANNIBALS_NIGHTMARE.name: Hannibal's Nightmare
HANNIBALS_NIGHTMARE.ability: TWIN SIEGE JAVELINS (SIEGE): fires at 2 targets per shot. Deals 6.5x damage vs War Elephants and Undead War Elephants, +60% vs Flyers, and +30% vs true Bosses. Every 10s it freezes nearby enemies and briefly concussion-stuns freeze-immune elephants. The apex anti-elephant T5, built for cracking elite elephant packs. Siege damage bypasses ranged-resistant armor.

GOD_OF_WAR.name: God of War
GOD_OF_WAR.ability: APEX MELEE: +35% direct damage against bosses, elites, and commanders. Stamps HELLFIRE on every strike (1% maxHP/sec, permanent — TRUE damage that bypasses faction resistance; the primary melee swing still takes normal resistance). Leaves BURNING GROUND for 4.4s on every hit. DIVINE EXECUTE: any enemy left at 12% HP or below after a hit is instantly killed — bosses included.

VEXILLATION.name: Vexillation
VEXILLATION.ability: MOB CRUSHER: cleaves all enemies in melee range. +18% damage per additional enemy in range (cap +90%). Hard counter to swarms.

TESSERARIUS.name: Tesserarius
TESSERARIUS.ability: SIGNAL STANDARD: every hit applies Armor Shred (3s). Every 3rd hit on a Boss plants a SIGNAL MARK — the boss takes +20% damage from ALL towers (6s, refreshes on each re-mark). Direct hits only — DoT ticks (burn, poison, bleed, hellfire) are NOT amplified, so the mark rewards stacking direct-damage towers on the boss, not DoT spam. Dedicated boss-fight support amplifier.

SCOUT_VEXILLUM.name: Scout Vexillum
SCOUT_VEXILLUM.ability: BATTLE PAINTER: every 4s applies MARK (+20% taken) to ALL enemies in range. Javelins are dipped in BOG VENOM: every hit also applies POISON (5% maxHP/sec, 4.4s, scales with tier). Mark + per-target DoT + range 4.8 = early-game force multiplier.

STORMCALLER.name: Stormcaller
STORMCALLER.ability: ARC LIGHTNING: each shot chains to 4 nearby enemies, decaying 25% per jump. Stuns the primary target. STORM CONDUCTOR: +100% damage vs ocean / sea-based enemies - soaked bodies carry the lightning. Fire, burn, and hellfire still do zero damage to those water-born threats.

SACER_VESTAL.name: Vestalis
SACER_VESTAL.ability: VESTAL SANCTUM: doubles ALL status durations applied to enemies in range. Pure support priest.

TRIBUNUS_LATICLAVIUS.name: Tribunus
TRIBUNUS_LATICLAVIUS.ability: TIME WARP: every hit applies 65% Slow for 3s. Deals +45% direct damage to elites and commanders, letting the Tribunus suppress priority threats instead of merely blanketing grunts.

NEMESIS_ENGINE.name: Nemesis Engine
NEMESIS_ENGINE.ability: SKY-RIPPER: extreme 12-tile siege reach, no longer map-wide. +220% damage to Flyers, always prioritizes Flyers. SKYFALL briefly Stuns flyers, ARMOR SHREDS them, and marks them for +35% damage taken. Still a brutal air-wave opener, but placement matters.

TRIUMPHATOR.name: Triumphator
TRIUMPHATOR.ability: VICTOR'S SWEEP: cleaves all enemies in melee range. Every 5th hit unleashes a radial NOVA for 4× damage in 2.5 tiles. TRIUMPHAL WREATH: each kill this wave adds +1.5% damage (cap +30%, resets between waves). +40% damage vs Bosses (+55% at T5). Applies Bleed on every hit.

PONTIFEX_MAXIMUS.name: Pontifex
PONTIFEX_MAXIMUS.ability: RITE OF DOOM (MELEE CLEAVE — POLEARM REACH 2.0): cleaves every enemy in melee range each swing (secondaries 70%). +200% damage to Bosses. Every hit on a boss refreshes a HELLFIRE curse (1% maxHP/sec per tower tier, permanent until the boss dies). The High Priest strikes with a sanctified ritual blade — bring him to the front line.

TURMA_LANCERS.name: Turma Lancers
TURMA_LANCERS.ability: POLEARM REACH (range 2.0): COMBO-OF-COMBO (T3): twin Horsemen reforged. CHARGE applies double-stack Mark on hit, +45% vs ground.

AURORA_LEGION.name: Aurora Legion
AURORA_LEGION.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T4): divine artillery. Pierces 4 targets per attack. +50% damage vs ELITE archetype. PROVIDENCE BLAST: every 4th attack fires a divine nova in a 1.8-tile radius around the primary target dealing 2.5× damage to all enemies inside (radiant burst).

STORM_VEXILLATION.name: Storm Vexilla
STORM_VEXILLATION.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T4): Stormcaller forged into a banner. Heavy divine bolt that chains to 6 enemies, retaining 80% damage per jump (20% decay) — a real step up from the Stormcaller it was forged from.

IMPERIUM_ETERNUM.name: Imperium Eternum
IMPERIUM_ETERNUM.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T5 APEX): every hit detonates a divine quake — 3-tile AoE at 90% damage as TRUE damage (primary projectile still takes resist). Leaves burning ground. Global +25% attack speed aura.

CARTHAGE_SCOURGE.name: Carthage Scourge
CARTHAGE_SCOURGE.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T5 SIEGE): SIX-bolt volley at distinct targets per attack. +320% vs Bosses. AoE freeze every 5s. Siege damage bypasses ranged resists. Expensive enough that it should feel like a real late boss answer.

TRIUMVIRATE.name: Triumvirate
TRIUMVIRATE.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T5 SUPPORT): triple-aura. +40% global damage, +30% global attack speed, all enemies take +30% damage. Pure support — does no direct damage.

TRIPLEX_ACIES.name: Triplex Acies
TRIPLEX_ACIES.ability: SUPER COMBO (5 BASE T2): cleaves all enemies in 2-tile melee range (secondaries 70%), +25% atk speed aura to nearby towers (3 tiles). Hard to make, very rewarding.

LEGION_PRIME.name: Legion Prime
LEGION_PRIME.ability: SUPER COMBO (3 BASE T3): heavy AoE divine artillery. +25% damage aura to all towers within 3 tiles. Applies SLOW + Armor Shred on every hit. BOSS HUNTER — crit chance jumps from 20% to 80% against any boss target, multiplying the heavy shell by 2.5×.

CONSULAR_FATEBINDER.name: Fatebinder
CONSULAR_FATEBINDER.ability: SUPER COMBO APEX (3 BASE T4, MELEE): primary strike deals TRUE damage (ignores resists), then a divine echo strikes EVERY OTHER enemy on the map at 45% splash. Burns ground on every hit. +22% global damage AND +22% global attack speed aura.

SIGNIFERS_DRACONARIUS.name: Draconarius
SIGNIFERS_DRACONARIUS.ability: 60° fire-breath CONE at polearm reach 2.0 hits every enemy in the arc. Each hit stacks DRAGON MARK (+25%/stack, cap +75%). PROXIMITY BURN auto-ignites enemies within 2 tiles. +60% vs Bosses.

BESTIARIUS.name: Bestiarius
BESTIARIUS.ability: BEAST FURY (fast gauge): rapid polearm strikes at 2.75/s. Each consecutive attack on the SAME target builds 1 fury stack (max 8). At 8, the strike becomes a FRENZY: 6× damage + 1.2s STUN, then the gauge resets. Against Bosses, the gauge fills 2× faster and FRENZY rises to 8×. Polearm reach 2.0. No aura; this is sustained stack-payoff damage.

BEAST_HUNTER.name: Beast Hunter
BEAST_HUNTER.ability: BEAST-BANE: +200% damage vs animal-faction enemies (Feral / Rabid / Alpha Dog · Demon Hellhound · War Elephant · Undead War Elephant). Lightning-fast dual-blade slashes (2.8/s). Combo ingredient for Murmillo — the heavy fish-helmet gladiator inherits the dimachaerus' speed training. Pure melee, range 2.0.

BEAST_SLAYER.name: Beast Slayer
BEAST_SLAYER.ability: BEAST-BANE: +200% damage vs animal-faction enemies, including living War Elephants and Undead War Elephants. Veteran Beast Hunter upgrade — heavier strike, still fast (2.6/s), better crit profile (15% / 2.0×). Combo ingredient for Bestiarius (gladiator beast-fury combo). Pure melee, range 2.0. Specialist answer to the W3 Alpha Dog, the W9-10 War Elephant pair, and the W14 Undead Elephant. Rolls at T1-T3 in the prospect pool so a dog-heavy early wave can still hand you one on a fresh T1 draw.

MURMILLO.name: Murmillo
MURMILLO.ability: MID-GAME COMBO MELEE — the Roman fish-helmet gladiator. BEAST-BLOOD: +50% damage to all beasts, including dogs, Hellhounds, War Elephants, and Undead War Elephants. PUNIC HUNTER: +75% damage vs CARTHAGE and +50% vs UNDEAD_CARTHAGE. SCUTUM BASH: every 4th swing STUNS non-bosses for 1.44s and knocks the target back 0.8 tiles. Recipe = Beast Hunter + Turris + Arcuballista.

HERO_MARIUS.name: Gaius Marius
HERO_MARIUS.ability: Father of the Legion. Nearby melee towers gain +35% damage. MARIAN FORMATION: the 5 nearest melee towers gain +75% attack speed, +30% damage, and shared crit for 5s. CAPITE CENSI: 3 phantom auxilia hurl pila within 2.5 tiles, prioritize bosses and commanders, and deal +50% damage to those leaders. Heroic crit profile: 50% × 2.0.

HERO_AGRIPPA.name: Marcus Agrippa
HERO_AGRIPPA.ability: Admiral of the Fleet. Siege hero with 10-tile cannon-range reach and a local damage-and-range aura for nearby siege towers. Abilities: Pilum Volley (5 javelins on 5 highest-HP enemies, pierces 2) and Naval Bombardment (3 splash shells stun). Heroic crit profile (50% × 2.0).

HERO_AGRICOLA.name: Gnaeus Agricola
HERO_AGRICOLA.ability: Governor of the Frontier. Seven-tile longbow reach. Global anti-air passive lets every tower target flyers and adds anti-flyer damage, plus abilities Eagle Scout (marks every flyer for +60% damage taken) and Frontier Wall (slows flyers 70% + every tower deals +25% vs flyers). Heroic crit profile (50% × 2.0).

HERO_SCIPIO.name: Scipio Africanus
HERO_SCIPIO.ability: Conqueror of Carthage. Global priority-target passive boosts the whole map against bosses and commanders, plus hunting abilities Cornu Charge (5× burst on highest-HP boss or commander, 6s cooldown) and Scipio's Brand (marks every boss and commander for +30% damage-taken, 6s). Heroic crit profile (50% × 2.0).

HERO_CAESAR.name: Julius Caesar
HERO_CAESAR.ability: Dictator of Rome. Global command aura boosts tower damage and attack speed, plus battlefield-control abilities SPQR Decree and Pax Romana. Heroic crit profile (50% × 2.0).

HERO_SULLA.name: Lucius Sulla
HERO_SULLA.ability: The Fortunate. Every basic meteor leaves BURNING GROUND for 4.4s. PYRE WARD: every tower within 5.5 tiles keeps its own damage type and adds bonus FIRE damage on each hit. Meteor Slam calls down a burning meteor every 7s, splashing, burning, and leaving another 4.4s fire patch on impact. Proscription temporarily overrides every tower's base damage to DIVINE, bypassing all faction resistances. Heroic crit profile (50% × 2.0).

MARS_VICTOR.name: Mars Victor
MARS_VICTOR.ability: THE WAR-GOD INCARNATE, forged from all 6 Champions of Rome. 2400 DPS, strikes as BOTH Siege and Divine. Fuses every hero passive into one army-wide aura: +35% damage and +20% attack speed to EVERY tower, all towers may strike flyers, and +25% damage vs bosses and commanders. TRIUMPH OF MARS: every 3rd hit unleashes a divine shockwave that smites all enemies within 3.5 tiles for TRIPLE damage. Worth far more than the six heroes combined after a 6000g recruitment path.

CHAMPION_MARIUS.name: Champion Marius
CHAMPION_MARIUS.ability: Champion of Rome, recruited at Mercator for 1000g. Uses Marius's full aura and abilities, including Capite Censi's +50% damage against bosses and commanders. Field all SIX Champions, then combine them into MARS VICTOR.

CHAMPION_AGRIPPA.name: Champion Agrippa
CHAMPION_AGRIPPA.ability: Champion of Rome, recruited at Mercator for 1000g. Field all SIX Champions, then combine them into MARS VICTOR, the divine apex super-tower.

CHAMPION_AGRICOLA.name: Champion Agricola
CHAMPION_AGRICOLA.ability: Champion of Rome with seven-tile longbow reach, recruited at Mercator for 1000g. Field all SIX Champions, then combine them into MARS VICTOR, the divine apex super-tower.

CHAMPION_SCIPIO.name: Champion Scipio
CHAMPION_SCIPIO.ability: Champion of Rome, recruited at Mercator for 1000g. Field all SIX Champions, then combine them into MARS VICTOR, the divine apex super-tower.

CHAMPION_CAESAR.name: Champion Caesar
CHAMPION_CAESAR.ability: Champion of Rome, recruited at Mercator for 1000g. Field all SIX Champions, then combine them into MARS VICTOR, the divine apex super-tower.

CHAMPION_SULLA.name: Champion Sulla
CHAMPION_SULLA.ability: Champion of Rome, recruited at Mercator for 1000g. Retains Pyre Ward, Meteor Slam, Proscription, and 4.4s BURNING GROUND on every basic meteor and Meteor Slam impact. Field all SIX Champions, then combine them into MARS VICTOR.

PRAETORIAN_EXECUTIONER.name: Praetorian Executioner
PRAETORIAN_EXECUTIONER.ability: Heavy maul. EXECUTIONER'S RHYTHM: every 2nd strike STUNS 0.96s — and he deals +40% damage to any STUNNED, SLOWED, or FROZEN target, caving in everything his own lockdown leaves helpless.

SACRED_BAND.name: Sacred Band
SACRED_BAND.ability: Holy blade — DIVINE melee that bypasses most resistances. AEGIS NOVA: every 4th strike erupts a 2-tile divine shockwave for 2.2× damage that STUNS everything caught (0.48s). Elite anti-armor + area lockdown.

BEASTLORD_CHAMPION.name: Beastlord Champion
BEASTLORD_CHAMPION.ability: BEAST DOMINION: +75% damage to beasts and +125% to living or undead war elephants. Beast hits MARK +15% for 3s. Requires an anti-air item, CYAN aura tile, Agricola aura, or Mars Victor aura to hit FLYERS; once enabled, deals +100% to flyers and briefly STUNS and MARKS them +20%.

MIRMILLO_REAVER.name: Murmillo Reaver
MIRMILLO_REAVER.ability: BEAST REAVER: +50% damage to all beasts, including dogs, Hellhounds, and living or undead War Elephants. SICA PRESSURE: every hit refreshes BLEED at 1.2% max HP per second for 6.6s; an already bleeding target takes +25% direct damage.

TRIBUNE_AVENGER.name: Tribune Avenger
TRIBUNE_AVENGER.ability: AVENGER'S EDICT: DIVINE melee with 2.5-tile reach. Every strike applies POISON at 5% max HP per second for 3.3s, halving continuous regeneration. Every 4th strike also MARKS the target +18% for 3s.

CATAPHRACT_LANCER.name: Cataphract Lancer
CATAPHRACT_LANCER.ability: LONG LANCE (3.0-tile reach). LANCE CHARGE: every 3rd couched thrust STUNS 1.2s and knocks the target back about 0.5 tiles. Slow, devastating swings make it a second-rank wall anchor that pins and shoves bosses down the lane.

STORM_BALLISTA.name: Storm Ballista
STORM_BALLISTA.ability: Long-range SIEGE bolt-thrower with 1.4-tile splash. AERIAL BREACH: targets FLYERS without the normal siege miss penalty, pierces aerial plating, and deals +110% damage to them. SHOCK BURST: every 3rd bolt STUNS every enemy in the splash for 0.72s.

SKYREAPER_BATTERY.name: Skyreaper Battery
SKYREAPER_BATTERY.ability: Eagle-eyed volley. Targets flyers only. Pierces aerial plating for +250% damage vs FLYERS and another +25% against flying bosses and commanders. FLAK WEB: hits slow flyers by 55% and apply ARMOR SHRED, opening them to the whole defense.

PLAGUE_LOBBER.name: Plague Lobber
PLAGUE_LOBBER.ability: CONTAGION POT: 5-tile lob with 1.5-tile splash. Impact leaves BURNING GROUND for 4.4s and applies POISON at 5% max HP per second for 3.85s. Either DoT halves continuous regeneration while active.

AUGURS_WRATH.name: Augur's Wrath
AUGURS_WRATH.ability: Hurls a radiant omen-fireball. DIVINE damage with 1.0-tile splash that sets the struck cluster BURNING. Strong magic artillery, now priced as a real T3-priest investment instead of a cheap early skip.

UNDEAD_GENERAL.name: Undead General
UNDEAD_GENERAL.ability: DEAD LEGION COMMAND: Tier IV melee cleaver with 3.0-tile command reach, forged from Primus Pilus + Evocatus. BEAST EXTERMINATOR: deals 2.25x damage to beasts and 3x damage to living or undead war elephants. Every beast hit applies ARMOR SHRED for 3s so the legion can finish the prey.

EXPLORATORES.name: Exploratores
EXPLORATORES.ability: RECON VOLLEY (T3): fires at 3 targets per shot. Every hit applies MARK (+15% damage taken). REVEALS stealthed / ambush enemies in range for every tower. +50% damage vs RUNNER archetype. A utility scout combo, not a cheap all-purpose carry.

VULCAN_BOMBARD.name: Vulcan Bombard
VULCAN_BOMBARD.ability: MAGMA BARRAGE (SIEGE, T3): heavy 2.6-tile splash. Every blast stamps stacking ARMOR SHRED (drops resists, 3s) on the crater AND a 0.54s STUN on the primary. Strong siege setup, but no longer the cheapest map-clearing answer.

VANGUARD_WING.name: Vanguard Wing
VANGUARD_WING.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T4): EAGLE-EYE BARRAGE — fires at 4 targets. Every hit applies MARK + ARMOR SHRED. REVEALS stealthed enemies. +40% damage vs ELITE archetype. Every 4th volley plants a SIGNAL MARK on a Boss (+20% damage taken from ALL towers, 6s).

VULCAN_COLOSSUS.name: Vulcan Colossus
VULCAN_COLOSSUS.ability: COMBO-OF-COMBO (T5 SIEGE): CITY-BREAKER — massive 3.5-tile splash with stacking ARMOR SHRED + 0.96s AoE STUN on every blast. +100% damage vs Bosses. Every 3rd shot is a TITAN ROUND dealing 2.5× damage across the splash. Siege bypasses ranged resists.

SKY_DOMINION.name: Sky Dominion
SKY_DOMINION.ability: SUPERCOMBO APEX (3 COMBOS): six-target eagle barrage. Pierces aerial plating, +325% damage vs FLYERS, and +60% vs ELITES. Every hit MARKS + ARMOR SHREDS; flyer hits also SLOW hard. Every 5th volley casts SKY DECREE, stunning every flyer in range and marking them harder. Reveals stealth for the whole defense.

AUREATE_TRIBUNAL.name: Aureate Tribunal
AUREATE_TRIBUNAL.ability: SUPERCOMBO APEX SUPPORT (3 COMBOS): +55% global damage, +40% global attack speed, and enemies in 6.5 tiles take +40% damage. Every 4s the tribunal marks all enemies in range and pays +25 gold if any boss is standing trial. Pure economy/support payoff.

GLACIAL_PALISADE.name: Glacial Palisade
GLACIAL_PALISADE.ability: SUPERCOMBO APEX MELEE (3 COMBOS): cleaves the lane with DIVINE frost. Every hit SLOWS, FREEZES briefly, and MARKS. Every 4th strike erupts a 2.8-tile AEGIS BLIZZARD for 1.8× damage, freezing the cluster and shielding nearby towers with +20% damage.

INFERNAL_COLOSSUS.name: Infernal Colossus
INFERNAL_COLOSSUS.ability: SUPERCOMBO APEX SIEGE (3 COMBOS): volcanic 4-tile splash, +200% vs Bosses, permanent stronger HELLFIRE on hit, ARMOR SHRED across the crater. Every 3rd shot is a DOOM ROUND for 2.5× splash damage and a 1.2s crater stun. Siege bypasses ranged resists.

ROMAN_TRANSFORMER.name: Roman Transformer
ROMAN_TRANSFORMER.ability: OMEGA COMBO TOWER (Hannibal's Nightmare + Julius Caesar): Roman automaton with twin curved blades. DIVINE MELEE at 6 tiles; requires an anti-air item or aura to reach flyers. Cleaves, and every hit MARKS, ARMOR SHREDS, STUNS briefly, and stamps BURN + HELLFIRE. IMMOLATION AURA burns legal targets within 1.5 tiles. OMEGA DECREE: every 120s during an active wave, slashes 25% current HP from every enemy it can legally hit. Also projects a 6-tile enemy vulnerability aura (+55% damage taken). Insanely expensive, insanely decisive.

NEPTUNES_LEVIATHAN.name: Neptune's Leviathan
NEPTUNES_LEVIATHAN.ability: WATER-ONLY OMEGA COMBO (Abyssal Onager + Hydra Beast Pit): 2.5-tile DIVINE melee from ocean tiles only; requires an anti-air item or aura to reach flyers. Cleaves and deals +35% vs elites, bosses, and commanders plus +30% vs ocean-spawn enemies. Every hit MARKS +30%, ARMOR SHREDS, SLOWS 50%, briefly STUNS, and adds POISON. Undertow Aura pulses every 0.5s in 2.5 tiles, slowing 35% and poisoning legal targets. Abyssal Judgment fires every 35s and removes 18% current HP from legal targets inside that aura. Very high payoff, but only if your maze brings enemies close to the water.

TRIREME_BALLISTA.name: Trireme Ballista
TRIREME_BALLISTA.ability: OCEAN ONLY. 8-tile SIEGE bolt with 0.8-tile splash and +45% damage against elites, bosses, and commanders. Every hit applies ARMOR SHRED, restoring resisted Physical Melee and Ranged damage; priority targets also receive MARK +12% for 2.5s.

CORVUS_BOARDING_SHIP.name: Corvus Boarding Ship
CORVUS_BOARDING_SHIP.ability: OCEAN ONLY. 2.4-tile PHYSICAL MELEE support hook. Hits ground enemies, briefly STUNS them for 0.42s, and MARKS them +16% for 2.5s. Use it near turns or shoreline choke points to hold enemies in range and amplify melee-heavy defenses.

RAMMING_QUINQUEREME.name: Ramming Quinquereme
RAMMING_QUINQUEREME.ability: OCEAN ONLY. Slow 6.5-tile DIVINE ram with 1-tile splash and +50% damage against elites and bosses. Every hit knocks enemies back about 0.45 tiles. Every 3rd impact STUNS 0.54s and applies ARMOR SHRED for 4s.

CHARYBDIS_VORTEX.name: Charybdis Vortex
CHARYBDIS_VORTEX.ability: OCEAN ONLY. 5.2-tile DIVINE control with 0.8-tile splash. Every hit SLOWS 48% for 3.5s and pulls slightly; bosses and commanders also receive ARMOR SHRED. Every 4th hit blocks regeneration and checkpoint healing for 2.25s. Its visible current confirms control.

NEREID_ORACLE.name: Nereid Oracle
NEREID_ORACLE.ability: OCEAN ONLY. 6-tile DIVINE support shot that reveals stealth and resistance information. FATED CURRENT applies MARK +20% and a separate, non-stacking +10% direct-damage vulnerability for 4s. DoT is not amplified.

HYDRA_OF_LERNA.name: Hydra of Lerna
HYDRA_OF_LERNA.ability: OCEAN ONLY. 4-tile DIVINE hydra attacking at 1.65/s, with +35% damage against elites and beasts. Every 4 kills grows a head: +11% damage and +4% speed, up to 7. Every 4th hit applies 6.05s BLEED, halving continuous regeneration.

PRAETORIAN_FLEET.name: Praetorian Fleet
PRAETORIAN_FLEET.ability: TIDEFORGED COMBO: Trireme Ballista + Scorpio. 8.5-tile, 1.1-tile SIEGE splash applies ARMOR SHRED and MARK. Ocean stance grants +34.4% damage, +0.65 range, and +45% against priority targets. Land grants +8% speed and +25% against priority targets.

CORVUS_LEGION_DOCK.name: Corvus Legion Dock
CORVUS_LEGION_DOCK.ability: TIDEFORGED COMBO: Corvus Boarding Ship + Cohort Guard. Can be placed on ocean or land. Ocean deployment grants +20% damage; its Tideforged stance adds another +12% damage and +0.65 range. Land placement gives +8% attack speed. Ground hits STUN 0.66s and MARK +24% on water, or STUN 0.42s and MARK +18% on land. Use as a melee control anchor.

ORACLE_LIGHTHOUSE.name: Oracle Lighthouse
ORACLE_LIGHTHOUSE.ability: TIDEFORGED COMBO: Nereid Oracle + Speculator. Reveals stealth. Ocean stance grants +34.4% damage, +0.65 range, MARK +28%, and Fated Current +14% for 5.5s. Land grants +8% speed, MARK +36%, and Fated Current +18% for 4s.

ABYSSAL_ONAGER.name: Abyssal Onager
ABYSSAL_ONAGER.ability: TIDEFORGED COMBO: Charybdis Vortex + Siege Onager. 2.2-tile SIEGE splash applies ARMOR SHRED. Ocean stance SLOWS 55% for 4s; land SLOWS 32% for 2.6s. Every 3rd shot STUNS 0.72s and blocks regeneration plus checkpoint healing for 3s.

HYDRA_BEAST_PIT.name: Hydra Beast Pit
HYDRA_BEAST_PIT.ability: TIDEFORGED COMBO: Hydra of Lerna + Beastarius. +35% against elites and beasts. Ocean stance adds +34.4% damage, +0.65 range, and +40% against ocean spawns; heads grow every 4 kills. Land grants +8% speed; heads grow every 5 kills. Every 4th hit BLEEDS and halves regeneration.

MARS_TIDAL_BASTION.name: Mars' Tidal Bastion
MARS_TIDAL_BASTION.ability: TIDEFORGED COMBO: Ramming Quinquereme + Cohort Guard. DIVINE splash ram knocks back and MARKS +16%. Ocean stance grants +34.4% damage and +65% against priority targets; land grants +8% speed and +35%. Every 3rd hit STUNS 0.78s and applies ARMOR SHRED for 4.5s.

GIANT_KILLER.name: Giant Killer
GIANT_KILLER.ability: GIANT'S BANE TRANSFORMATION: equip the legendary Giant's Bane item onto a Tier V Milites to awaken this hulking Roman giant. Holds four total items, with one slot permanently bound to Giant's Bane. COLOSSAL DRAW: fires one enormous siege-bow arrow about every 3.3 seconds before bonuses. COLOSSAL IMPACT: each arrow creates a visible 1.6-tile shockwave; nearby enemies take 50% damage and calculate their own giant or elephant weakness. GIANT SLAYER: deals 5.5x damage vs sea giants, fire giants, cyclopses, undead giants, and colossal mythic giants; giant-class targets are marked and hindered on impact. ELEPHANT HUNTER: deals 3.5x damage vs living and undead war elephants.

GIANTS_COHORT_GUARD.name: Giant's Cohort Guard
GIANTS_COHORT_GUARD.ability: GIANT'S BANE AWAKENING: equip Giant's Bane onto a Tier V Cohort Guard. Holds four items; the relic remains bound. TITAN HUNTERS: measured four-target cleave and a +10% local damage aura. Deals 9x damage to sea giants, fire giants, Cyclopses, undead giants, and colossal mythic giants. Giant hits mark, slow, and periodically stun. Ordinary enemies and non-giant bosses receive no prey bonus.

UNDEAD_GLADIATOR_KING.name: Undead Gladiator King
UNDEAD_GLADIATOR_KING.ability: WITCH'S BREW TRANSFORMATION: a Tier IV or V Murmillo awakens into this necromancer gladiator, holds four items, and binds the Brew. Retains +50% damage to all beasts and stronger damage into CARTHAGE and UNDEAD_CARTHAGE. Heavy cleaves hit clustered ground enemies; every 4th swing stuns and knocks back. Every 10 seconds, raises 3 undead gladiators for 20 seconds to chase, strike, and slow enemies.

IMPERIAL_HEADSMAN.name: Imperial Headsman
IMPERIAL_HEADSMAN.ability: ITEM-AWAKENED SUPERCOMBO: a Tier IV or V Praetorian Executioner bearing Damnatio Memoriae becomes an undead skeletal imperial guard. Holds four items; the relic is bound. Heavy full-power falx cleave. Every second strike STUNS. Executes ordinary enemies below 30% HP and elites or commanders below 18%. Bosses cannot be executed; hits CONDEMN them to take +35% damage for 5s.

SOL_INVICTUS_QUADRIGA.name: Sol Invictus Quadriga
SOL_INVICTUS_QUADRIGA.ability: ITEM-AWAKENED SUPERCOMBO: a Tier IV or V War Chariot bearing the Sigil of Sol Invictus becomes a solar quadriga. Holds four items; the sigil is bound. Tramples in melee and adds 35% DIVINE damage without replacing melee. Every 4th attack sends a spectral chariot down its lane, damaging a line, knocking ordinary enemies backward, and ARMOR SHREDDING bosses and commanders. The sigil retains its devastating anti-demon bonus.

JOVIAN_SKY_HUNTER.name: Jovian Sky Hunter
JOVIAN_SKY_HUNTER.ability: ITEM-AWAKENED SUPERCOMBO: a Tier IV or V Beastlord Champion bearing Storm Aquila Talons becomes a dedicated anti-air hunter. Holds four items; the talons are bound. Targets FLYERS only and fires chained lightning harpoons at 3 flyers. Its innate +35% flyer damage stacks with the bound Talons. Prioritizes flying bosses, commanders, and transporters; deals another +35% to major flyers and +50% to ocean flyers.

MEFITIS_PLAGUE_ENGINE.name: Mefitis Plague Engine
MEFITIS_PLAGUE_ENGINE.ability: ITEM-AWAKENED SUPERCOMBO: a Tier IV or V Plague Lobber bearing the Censer of Mefitis becomes a siege plague engine. Holds four items; the censer is bound. Slow 2-tile SIEGE splash keeps a physical corrosion impact even against fire or poison immunity. Successive clouds rotate BURN, POISON, and ARMOR SHRED. Every cloud blocks regeneration and checkpoint healing for 4s.
